Name: NarMiau Farm2 Small (EN Translation)
Author: ZhenShenius
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Farm Map Series: "Sleeping Kitty" (Small Version)[/b][/size][/center]

[line]

[size=4][b]MAP OVERVIEW[/b][/size] A tiny but incredibly cozy map that has everything you need. To give you full creative freedom, the map isn't cluttered with forced obstacles. It’s the perfect choice for a mod-heavy save or a lower-end PC, ensuring a smooth experience while you farm and explore the world. ;)

[b]Standalone Map:[/b] This map does not replace the vanilla farms. Select it from the list of available farms when creating a new character (Nar IIS).

[b]Pre-set Areas:[/b] Enjoy a dedicated meadow with blue grass for your livestock and a woodland patch with stumps for wood harvesting.

[b]Spa Corner:[/b] A special spot where you can restore your energy during the day right from the start.

[b]Unique Design:[/b] A special guardian lives on your farm—a cat whose eyes glow softly in the dark. (Can be toggled in settings).

[line]

[size=4][b]SUGGESTED ZONES & LAYOUT[/b][/size] The farm features a clean square layout divided into four functional zones:

[b]Living Zone:[/b] Contains your farmhouse, greenhouse, spouse area, pet bowl, and shipping bin. Access to: Cave, Bus Stop, and Cindersap Forest.

[b]Farming Zone:[/b] A large, open space without fences—perfect for crops. Access to: Backwoods and Cindersap Forest.

[b]Animal Zone:[/b] A fenced territory with blue grass. Animals cannot leave this area!

[b]Open Forest Zone:[/b] Ideal for an orchard or beehives. Includes Grandpa’s Shrine and a hidden path to the Secret Woods.

[quote][b]Note:[/b] All ground on the farm is tillable—you can plant crops in any zone you like![/quote]

[line]

[size=4][b]HOME & STARTING THE GAME[/b][/size]

[b]Interior:[/b] Comes with a pre-decorated cozy interior (bed, TV, table, dresser, and rugs).

[b]Starter Kit:[/b] You'll receive an enlarged chest for your first resources. Choose between "Standard" or "Extended" in the config.

[line]

[size=4][b]AVAILABLE SETTINGS[/b][/size] (Use Generic Mod Config Menu or edit the config.json)

[b]Starter Kit:[/b] Standard / Extended (Set this BEFORE creating a new save).

[b]Glowing Cat Eyes:[/b] On / Off.

[line]

[size=4][b]INSTALLATION[/b][/size]

Install [b]SMAPI[/b].

Install [b]Content Patcher[/b].

(Optional) Install [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b].

Unzip the archive into your [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b] folder.

Launch the game using SMAPI.

[line]

[center][i]"Sleeping Kitty" is a farm for those who value comfort, organization, and lag-free gameplay. Enjoy quiet evenings under the watchful gaze of the night cat.[/i][/center]
